title: Savoy Star social notes — Bramlett, Hollowell, Odell, Littrell, Durrett
text:
Mrs. Samantha Bramlett of Ladonia, came Monday to visit her son, R. H. Bramlett and family.

W. L. Hollowell had business in Bonham Wednesday.

J. M. Odell and Miss Effie Littrell were married at the bride's father's, D. M. Littrell, just west of town Wednesday morning at 9:30. They left immediately for Celeste, to make that their future home. L. H. Taylor performed the ceremony. The Star wishes them a prosperous married life.

Irving Durrett arrived yesterday from Santa Cruz, Cal. in response to a telegram from his father, stating that his brother, Elmer, was in a very critical condition with a small cut of an axe on his knee. The telegram was sent from here at 11 o'clock a. m. and reached Irving the same day at 10 o'clock a. m. We are sorry to say that Elmer is no better than he was last week.
